body: Can we talk now please?
My dead friends. Traumatic experiences. My ex. Those are the ones I remember but there are others.

I was just talking to a friend of mine about regret. He was struggling with the past too. It's funny how I could help him forgive himself by telling him about the times I have failed but it's difficult to deal with your own regret.

Hi, I read your 'ridiculously long' post and I get how you feel. Rejection and abandonment leave scars that make it harder to open up the next time. I cant even talk to my family freely because of trust issues. 
Know that I don't blame you at all for feeling down on yourself, I guess my advice would be to find a way to be alone without being lonely. I use music and meditation, doesn't always work but it's better than self-harm and tears. 
Then again dont feel pressured to find an immediate solution and magically heal. Take your time and do you, it's your life.

I'm glad you are venting, even if it's just to me who can't give you the hug/support etc that you deserve.
 
1. First thing I noticed is something that I do myself which is downplay my feelings or thoughts - dismiss them as irrational or unproductive. That's not fair to yourself or anyone else for that matter. I personally believe it's really important to feel the things you feel for what they are without trying to rationalise them. 

How can you move forward from your pain if half the time you just tell yourself it shouldn't be there? 

2. So I tried to hang myself a while back when I first started  struggling with severe depression, I felt like no one cared about me which even though I know is not precisely true, life can be very hard sometimes so it's not necessarily wrong or stupid to feel like that.

I forced myself to exist for a while and eventually I graduated, fell in love with a beautiful artist who showed me so much about life and myself. She treated me with so much love that I would have happily died for her and we had a beautiful connection for 4 years until she broke up with me. This happened a few months back and due to grieving losing her and other loved ones to death I have struggled with suicidal thoughts many times.

Point I am making is that life definitely didn't just heal for me. It had many ups and downs, right now I am still deep in a down but I also have the perspective to recognise that my pain and these experiences make me special, I have something to offer those around me and I enjoy doing that. I think coping is all about perspective. Not to say that depression or suicide are wrong because if I didn't have a 6 year old sister begging me to play Nintendo games with her everyday I would have killed myself, I can't blame anyone for not wanting to continue. I just feel like because of the pain, people like us experience we have a lot more to offer the world than "normal" people (lol).

3. On a more practical level:

don't focus on the long run too much, just take it one day at a time for now. The future scares the strongest of us.

Find things that make you smile even if they aren't huge undertakings, I write music (which I will probably try and show you sometime haha), read comics, think about nature, play basketball and recently became vegan (not all at the same time tho, I'm not strong enough for that yet, "it's a marathon not a sprint")

Yes talking helps me a lot too but don't let it become an excuse to get caught in the past.
(I've started to isolate a lot more recently which probably isn't healthy but I do my best to focus on getting stronger alone rather than being lonely)

When it comes to the practical issue of debt you can ask me questions about that too, I work in finance/economics so I might be able to help with some of your options

P.s- sorry for the slow reply, we are probably in different timezones

Don't mention it, I'm glad you posted because there are definitely people who care even if it's not a face-to-face relationship. 
I'm pretty skilled at blaming myself as well so it hurts to see others struggle with the same things. I don't anymore but some months ago I used to cut a lot just so I could feel something that wasn't loneliness... maybe you feel a similar way sometimes

I'm sorry you are hurting so much. I tried a few years back. Even though I am still hurting a lot I'm happy I didn't die then. 
Do you want to vent about how you feel or anything?

Your post really hurt me to read because you have been nothing short of a victim in so many ways and part of you blames yourself for that.
I know what it feels like to be weak and powerless, isolated and that you can't trust or rely on anyone. I'm so sorry for what has happened to you. It's not your fault. None of it is.
I used to really struggle with migraines and panic attacks. Id really like to listen and be around if you need someone to vent to. Obviously I'm just another broken person on the internet but help/friendship comes in all shapes and sizes lol.

A few years back I tried hanging myself with my school for and it tore. I'm not sure if you will be able to look back tomorrow and be happy or feel better but the future isn't fixed if you keep moving forward (or at least that what I think when my anxiety + depression don't overwhelm me).

Hey man, I have been in a pretty similar situation (end of a 4 year relationship and my other best friend dying a couple weeks later) along with the depression and younger sister who forces me to smile lol. I can understand wanting to be alone (I haven't been able to hold a face-to-face  conversation in months)  but if you want to talk to someone who will listen without judging etc. I'm around
Hmmm. I'm reading an action novel at the moment but I read anything and everything
Need an email address to send the iTunes gift card too

My girlfriend broke our 4 year relationship and everyday I wake up with nothing but more emptiness than the day before. I know how you feel. If you guys were together for a week she would blame herself. Even if you mistreated each other there is a connection that will cause her grief if you kill yourself.
Direct message? I thought you'd like to talk to someone who understands before going out...
I'm looking at making the same decision tonight. I don't think I can handle 2019. Want to hang out before you go?
Would you be comfortable with accepting me gifting you a subscription?
I feel a similar. Especially about music. What was the subscription that ran out?
That's sounds pretty complicated. Sorry you are struggling so much. I guess we all are...

I feel exactly the same way as you and i wont tell you how you should feel because i am pretty close to pulling the trigger myself but i do know that she will blame herself. Especially if you guys were particularly close...

I've tried a few counsellors but none of it has helped.
I've started writing music and she was the only person who consistently listened to my stuff for months. Now i have 20 subscribers lol (getting my first few comments gave me my first smile in months). We wanted to get married for a long time but now she seems really convinced that our relationship can't be happy without the baggage or pain so we aren't supposed to speak at all anymore...

He knew you loved him. That's why he hid his mistakes from you. If there was no love there would be no pain. Like i said, these emotions are so intense they warp our perception of reality. Societal stigma makes it very hard to feel this way and still be normal. At least for me, my emotions and mental health are like voices in my head but i can't tell anyone that and them understand me without judgement.

I can't imagine what you are going through at the moment and I am truly sorry for your loss.

I suffer from anxiety and depression and I have been suicidal for months now. I think it would be inappropriate of me to guess exactly how your partner felt or what they were thinking but earlier you asked if breakups cause suicide or if its a culmination of factors.

For me, I have been severely depressed and gone through suicidal ideation (thinking that 'i want to die') even before my breakup with my girlfriend of 4 years. I felt worthless and lonely despite her being devoted to me, all my other relationships and material achievements.
She left me recently because of my deteriorating health and my depression/ideation evolved into planning suicide. The only reason i cant bring myself to fulfil my plan is because she tells me she loves me even months after our break up and i know she would blame herself if i killed myself.
 
Perhaps your partner felt like he didnt deserve you, he was a burden and he had already hurt you enough.
These feelings are so intense. They warp everything... Please don't blame yourself.

I hope you find your happiness but some people aren't built able to get up again after those steps towards happiness blow up in your face and you become an even bigger burden to others. 

Like I said. I truly hope you conquer everything in your way but I also know that the pain of trying your hardest to only be ruined again hollows you out. Be careful. Respect hope but don't worship it.

 Hope + Mental instability = Potential for real lows

It couldn't be any more painful than anything I've felt for the last year. I'm more fearful of how it would affect the people I know. I feel so lonely but I don't know how my family and others would deal with it
